oauthSummary: Sandbox OAuth flow is not implemented. This loop is design-only and read-only. Seller authorization has not started. No auth URL, callback URL, token URL, endpoint, credential, secret, scope or token is included. IMNOVA must never store seller passwords. OAuth requires official eBay documentation validation before implementation. Token exchange, token storage, read-only connection, draft mapping, draft creation and publication remain blocked.

sellerAuthorizationModel.notes: Developer credentials identify the IMNOVA eBay app. The seller account authorizes the app later through OAuth. IMNOVA must never request or store seller passwords.
